declarations.docstring: The type of polynomial expressions associated with a finite tuple of square complex matrices.
The complex-algebra endomorphism on matrix-tuple polynomials induced by an invertible change of basis.
The transformed coordinate variable is weighted homogeneous of the variable's multidegree.
The transformed monomial is weighted homogeneous with degree obtained by weighting its exponent.
Taking a weighted homogeneous component commutes with the change-of-basis endomorphism.
The family of generic square matrices whose entries are matrix-tuple polynomials.
The complex subalgebra of matrix-tuple polynomials invariant under change of basis.
The multidegree of a matrix coordinate variable, indexed by its tuple position and matrix entries.
The polynomial obtained by taking the trace of the product of generic matrices specified by a word.
Every trace-word polynomial belongs to the change-of-basis invariant subalgebra.
Each weighted homogeneous component of an invariant polynomial remains in the invariant subalgebra.
